definition.simple: How seeds travel away from their parent plant to find a new place to grow.
definition.academic: The movement, spread or transport of seeds away from the parent plant to ensure survival and reduce competition.

examples: Dandelion seeds blowing in the wind.

common_misconceptions: Students think plants drop seeds right under them.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask what happens if 100 children try to sleep in one bed. Seeds need their own space!
